description: Offline interactive Marketing Management explorer for second-semester B.Com. LL.B. students: marketing concepts and environment, consumer behaviour and STP, product and branding, pricing, distribution and promotion, with the law on trade marks, labelling, e-commerce, misleading ads and dark patterns – labs, animations, quiz and certificate.
changes: 1.0.0 - first release: 6 units, buyer decision process and product life cycle animations, BCG matrix tool, positioning statement builder, markup/margin/break-even and channel price build-up calculators, 'Is this ad legal?' lab, 11 labs, 34 flashcards, 8 cases and rulings, 30-question quiz, references, progress bar and certificate
status: Complete for Semester II reference syllabus; replace unit details when TNNLU's official course outline is issued
